preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 200,000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between n - 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each vertex in the graph is numbered from 1 to n.
There are no self-loops in the graph.
The flow volume on each edge is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The graph is connected, meaning there is a path between any two vertices.
A solution to the problem always exists.

postconditions.expression: The output contains m lines, each containing one integer di.
postconditions.description: The output contains m lines, each containing one integer di, which is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: di should be 0 if the direction of the i-th edge is ai → bi.
postconditions.description: If di is 0, the flow goes from vertex ai to vertex bi.

postconditions.expression: di should be 1 if the direction of the i-th edge is bi → ai.
postconditions.description: If di is 1, the flow goes from vertex bi to vertex ai.

postconditions.expression: The sum of ci of incoming edges for each vertex v (1 < v < n) is equal to the sum of ci of outcoming edges.
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of ci of incoming edges is equal to the sum of ci of outcoming edges.

postconditions.expression: The obtained directed graph does not have cycles.
postconditions.description: The obtained directed graph does not have any cycles.
